data.title: Striped Halter Sleeveless Tank Causal Golden Button Decor Breathable Knit Top
data.description:
FABRIC - Breathable Viscose Knit: Crafted from 100% viscose, this premium knit fabric offers a silky-soft, lightweight handfeel with excellent breathability, delivering a comfortable, skin-friendly fit that gently skims the body without restriction, ensuring a cool and refined wearing experience throughout warm summer conditions.

SILHOUETTE - Elegant Slim-Fit Frame: Designed with a refined slim-fit silhouette and a classic halter neckline, this top softly contours the body while maintaining ease of wear, enhancing the shoulder line and elongating the visual proportions for a balanced, figure-flattering effect that offers a streamlined and structured appearance.

DESIGN - Gold Button & Striped Accent: Elevated by polished gold-tone button detailing and a timeless stripe pattern, this top reinterprets a classic essential with a refined aesthetic. The sleeveless cut and fine ribbed texture contribute to a structured yet understated finish, while the craftsmanship and overall quality exceed standard expectations.

STYLING - Polished Coastal Aesthetic: This striped camisole pairs seamlessly with tailored trousers, linen separates, denim pieces, or skirts. It may be layered under blazers for a refined office ensemble or styled independently for relaxed seasonal occasions, offering versatile styling adaptability across multiple settings.

OCCASIONS - Seamless Multi-Scene Utility: Suitable for daily wear, summer wardrobes, vacation styling, brunch occasions, café settings, office layering, shopping activities, and social gatherings, providing consistent adaptability across both casual and semi-formal scenarios.
